title: Wedding site with RSVP
when: The user wants a wedding, birthday or celebration site with details and an RSVP.
prompt:
Goal: An elegant page that gives guests every detail and collects the RSVP with no confusion.
Steps:
1. Hero with the couple names, date and city, and an RSVP button.
2. Story or welcome in a few warm sentences.
3. Details: ceremony and reception with time, address and map link; schedule of the day.
4. RSVP form: name, attending yes or no as radios, number of guests, dietary needs, message; without a backend use a mailto summary or say where answers go.
5. Travel, stay, dress code and gifts as short sections.
Quality bar:
- Script fonts only for names, never for body text.
- The RSVP deadline is visible near the form.
- Every field has a label.
Pitfalls:
- Light gold text on white that fails contrast.
- Forms that look like they send but go nowhere.
- Huge background images on mobile data.
Verify:
- [ ] RSVP radios are grouped with fieldset and legend.
- [ ] Labels on all fields.
- [ ] Contrast passes.
- [ ] Works at 375 px.
Output: index.html, style.css and a small form script if needed.

examples.input: site do nosso casamento com confirmação de presença
examples.output: names and date hero, ceremony and party details, RSVP form with attending radios and guest count
